description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage for five different models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Frames” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick marks every 100 units. The y-axis is labeled “Memory (GB)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks every 50 units. The red line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, is dashed with circular markers and begins at approximately 1 GB at 0 frames, increasing to approximately 18 GB at 1000 frames. The orange line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, is dashed with circular markers and begins at approximately 0.5 GB at 0 frames, increasing to approximately 32 GB at 1000 frames. The green line, representing PLLaVA, is solid with circular markers and begins at approximately 1 GB at 0 frames, increasing to approximately 65 GB at 1000 frames. The blue line, representing LLaVA-NeXT, is solid with circular markers and begins at approximately 2 GB at 0 frames, increasing to approximately 150 GB at 1000 frames. The pink line, representing VideoLLaVA, is dashed with circular markers and begins at approximately 1 GB at 0 frames, rapidly increasing to approximately 250 GB at 200 frames, and then continuing to approximately 380 GB at 1000 frames.
